source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Set the Thermal shutdown in the BIOS to Enabled/Disabled by following the below procedure:
    i) Navigate to System Utilities after the POST.
    ii) Navigate to System Utilities-> System Configuration-> System Options-> RBSU-> Advanced Options-> Fan and Thermal Options-> Thermal Shutdown.
    iii) Select the "Thermal Shutdown" and press "Enter" for a dialog box to open.
    iv) In the Dialog box, select "Enabled/Disabled" option. Save the settings by pressing "F10".
2. remove fan1
3. insert fan1
4. remove fan2 and fan3
5. insert fan2 and fan3
6. remove others fan
7. insert all fan

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. check bios disable  Thermal shutdown.
2. log should display remove fan1 error message,but won't shutdown.
3. log should display inseret fan1 message.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: ipmitool + BMC creds + operator (fail one fan)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- FAN Redundancy: verify fan redundancy: with one fan faulted (operator), confirm the other fans ramp to keep cooling ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" sensor list 2>&1 | grep -iE "FAN|SPD"; physical fault needed.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the fan sensors with one fan failed so the user confirms the remaining fans increased speed to maintain cooling (redundancy).

historical_reviews.deepseek: Partial one-fan outline omits multi-fan matrix.

original_test_intent: Exercise single and multi-fan removal states under a defined Thermal Shutdown policy, verify fault/recovery logs, cooling redundancy and host protection, then restore all fans.
original_method: An engineer configures BIOS and physically services specified fan combinations while telemetry and logs are captured.
manual_activity: Engineer controls BIOS and physical fan states; automation can monitor RPM, temperature, host behavior, SEL and restoration across the matrix.
required_inputs: Expected events, shutdown rules and recovery
safety_requirements: Use independent thermal monitoring and immediate reinsertion.
Stop on rising temperature or unexpected shutdown; no automatic retry.
Restore all fans and approved BIOS setting.
agent_execution_scope: Capture per-phase fan/RPM/temperature/host/SEL evidence around engineer actions.
Do not operate BIOS/hardware or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve phase matrix, perform fan service and observe physical state.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: One-fan sensor query is supporting evidence only and its plaintext credential form is rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use trusted fan/thermal/host telemetry for every approved combination.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BIOS setting and all named removal/insertion phases with 30/30 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Define the policy-state matrix, baseline all fans, execute each allowed removal combination under thermal aborts, verify events/continuity and fully restore.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact fan redundancy topology and BIOS policy.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor fan redundancy and Thermal Shutdown specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit phase expectations and combination safety.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Preserves single and multi-fan states rather than reducing to one fan.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Unsupported fan loss can overheat or shut down the host.

project_override_considerations: Any omitted combination must be declared; a project may approve a safer subset but cannot claim full source coverage.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The criteria cover only part of the procedure but do not contradict it; missing multi-fan expected results are readiness inputs requiring owner completion.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The physical matrix and intent are clear; manual setup plus automated monitoring is PARTIAL.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Requires phase-specific coverage and no-retry restore.

review_improvement: Prevents a single-fan result from satisfying the full multi-fan redundancy sequence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Every fan combination can be treated as a bounded engineer-created state with automatable telemetry; missing policy values affect readiness rather than automation capability.
